device.category: 4-voice analogue polyphonic synthesizer with digital multi engine and effects, 37 keys (also as the keyboardless xd module)
device.based_on: Analogue voice after the Korg prologue; successor to the minilogue (2016); released 2019.

sources.title: Korg minilogue xd / minilogue xd module Owner's Manual
sources.note: Panel, program architecture, every basic and edit-mode parameter, sequencer and motion sequencing, global settings, CV and sync, MIDI overview, effects list, program list, specifications.

architecture.polyphony_mode: 4-voice polyphonic; POLY (with DUO stacking), UNISON, CHORD or ARP/LATCH voice modes; poly-chain with a second unit
architecture.patch_memory_note: 500 programs (200 preset, 300 user by default), each with voice mode, effects and a 16-step sequence with up to four motion lanes; MASTER and joystick position not stored. Favourites on buttons 1-16.
architecture.summary: Per voice: two analogue VCOs (square, triangle or saw with a SHAPE control) with sync, ring and cross mod; a digital MULTI ENGINE (four filtered noises, a 16-type VPM oscillator, or up to 16 user oscillators via the logue SDK) mixed before or after the filter; a low-pass VCF with three-stage drive and keytrack; an ADSR on the VCA, an AD envelope to pitch or cutoff, and an LFO to cutoff, shape or pitch. Digital modulation (chorus, ensemble, phaser, flanger, user), delay and reverb. Voice modes, arpeggiator, 16-step polyphonic sequencer with motion, joystick, two CV inputs, oscilloscope display.

modules.name: Keyboard and voice assigner
modules.description: 37 slim velocity keys (buttons 1-16 on the module); assigns four voices per VOICE MODE; octave shift, portamento, microtuning, CV/gate input, damper.

modules.name: Joystick
modules.description: X: pitch bend (range per direction). Y+ and Y-: any of 29 assignable parameters at set ranges.

modules.name: Sequencer and arpeggiator
modules.description: 16-step polyphonic sequencer (step, real-time and motion recording, four motion lanes) and 13-type arpeggiator; 10-300 BPM, MIDI, USB or SYNC IN clock.

modules.name: VCO 1
modules.description: Analogue oscillator: square, triangle or saw, 16'-2', pitch ±1200 cents, SHAPE (duty cycle or waveshaping).

modules.name: VCO 2
modules.description: Analogue oscillator: square, triangle or saw, 16'-2', pitch ±1200 cents, SHAPE (duty cycle or waveshaping). Can be synced to, ring-modulated by and cross-modulated by VCO 1.

modules.name: MULTI ENGINE
modules.description: Digital engine: noise (High, Low, Peak, Decim), VPM oscillator (16 types, carrier and modulator with internal EG), or user oscillator (up to 16, logue SDK).

modules.name: Mixer
modules.description: VCO 1, VCO 2 and MULTI levels (0-1023) into the filter.

modules.name: VCF
modules.description: Analogue low-pass with resonance, three-step drive and three-step keytrack (centred on C4).

modules.name: Post-VCF mix
modules.description: Adds the MULTI ENGINE after the filter when Multi Routing is Post VCF.

modules.name: EG
modules.description: Attack/decay envelope with bipolar EG INT to pitch (all oscillators), pitch 2 (VCO 2) or cutoff.

modules.name: LFO
modules.description: Square, triangle or saw; 1-SHOT, NORMAL (0.05-28 Hz) or BPM-synced; to cutoff, shape or pitch.

modules.name: VCA
modules.description: Shapes each voice with the amp envelope and velocity.

modules.name: Effects
modules.description: Digital MOD (chorus, ensemble, phaser, flanger, user), DELAY (11 sub-types) and REVERB (10 sub-types), each with on/off, time, depth and wet/dry (delay, reverb).

modules.name: Output
modules.description: MASTER sets stereo output and headphone level.

modules.name: CV inputs
modules.description: CV IN 1 and 2: modulation of assignable parameters (-5 to +5 V), or pitch CV and gate (CV/Gate mode).

parameters.label: TEMPO
parameters.function: Program tempo for sequencer and arpeggiator.

parameters.label: VOICE MODE DEPTH
parameters.function: POLY: towards DUO stacking and detune. UNISON: detune 0-50 cents. CHORD: chord type. ARP: arpeggio type.

parameters.label: VOICE MODE TYPE
parameters.function: Voice mode (ARP/LATCH down again for latch).

parameters.label: TYPE (multi engine)
parameters.function: Noise: High, Low, Peak, Decim. VPM: Sin1-4, Saw1-2, Squ1-2, Fat1-2, Air1-2, Decay1-2, Creep, Throat. USR: user oscillator.

parameters.label: SHAPE (multi engine)
parameters.function: Noise: cutoff (10 Hz-21 kHz), bandwidth (110-880 Hz) or sample rate (240 Hz-48 kHz). VPM: modulation depth. USR: per oscillator.

parameters.label: SHIFT + SHAPE

access.gesture: hold SHIFT and turn the MULTI ENGINE SHAPE knob

parameters.function: Decim key track (0-100%), VPM ratio offset, or a user oscillator parameter.

parameters.label: KEYTRACK
parameters.function: Keyboard tracking of cutoff, centred on C4.

parameters.label: LFO MODE
parameters.function: One half-cycle per note, free 0.05-28 Hz, or BPM-synced.

parameters.label: LFO RATE
parameters.function: Rate, or a note division in BPM mode.

parameters.label: OFF/ON/SELECT
parameters.function: Effect off or on; SELECT steps types (SHIFT + SELECT for sub-types).

parameters.label: DEPTH (effects)
parameters.function: Effect depth; SHIFT + DEPTH sets delay or reverb wet/dry.

parameters.function: Mod type or sub-type, stored per effect with its on/off, time and depth.

parameters.label: DELAY type
parameters.function: Delay type or sub-type, stored per effect with its on/off, time and depth.

parameters.label: REVERB type
parameters.function: Reverb type or sub-type, stored per effect with its on/off, time and depth.

parameters.function: Cycles PROGRAM, SEQ and GLOBAL edit modes.

parameters.function: Saves the program; SHIFT + WRITE loads the panel.

parameters.function: Rest or tie (with a key held).

parameters.label: Buttons 1-16
parameters.function: Steps, favourites, edit pages; keyboard on the module.

parameters.function: Parameter the joystick moves in this direction.

parameters.label: Y- Assign
parameters.function: Parameter the joystick moves in this direction.

parameters.label: CV IN Mode
parameters.function: Modulation (assignable, -5..5 V) or CV/Gate (IN1 pitch -3..5 V, 1 V = C4; IN2 gate 0-5 V).

parameters.label: Microtuning
parameters.function: Equal Temp, Pure Major/Minor, Pythagorean, Werckmeister, Kirnberger, Slendro, Pelog, modes, Reverse, AFX 001-006, DC 001-003, User Scale 1-6, User Octave 1-6.

parameters.label: LFO Target OSC
parameters.function: Oscillators the LFO's shape or pitch modulation reaches.

parameters.function: Resets LFO phase on each note.

parameters.label: EG Legato

parameters.function: VPM mod attack offset, -100 to +100% (user oscillators: per SDK).

parameters.label: Parameter 5 (Mod Decay)
parameters.function: VPM mod decay offset, -100 to +100% (user oscillators: per SDK).

parameters.label: Parameter 6 (Mod Key Track)
parameters.function: VPM mod key track offset, -100 to +100% (user oscillators: per SDK).

ports.function: Analogue clock (20 V max); overrides MIDI clock when patched.

ports.function: Assignable modulation (-5..5 V) or pitch CV (-3..5 V, 1 V/oct, 1 V = C4).

behaviours.name: Voice modes
behaviours.rule: POLY: four voices, DEPTH moves towards DUO (two stacked, detuned voices per key). UNISON: all four on one note, DEPTH sets detune (0-50 cents). CHORD: DEPTH picks mono or one of 14 chord types. ARP/LATCH: arpeggiator (13 types), switch down again to latch.

behaviours.name: Signal path
behaviours.rule: Per voice: VCO 1, VCO 2 and the MULTI ENGINE into the mixer, the low-pass VCF and VCA (MULTI optionally after the filter). Four voices summed into the digital effects, then the stereo outputs.

behaviours.name: Oscillator interaction
behaviours.rule: SYNC resets VCO 2 from VCO 1; RING ring-modulates VCO 2 by VCO 1; CROSS MOD lets VCO 1 frequency-modulate VCO 2.

behaviours.name: MULTI ENGINE
behaviours.rule: Noise: high-pass, low-pass, peak or decimated noise, SHAPE setting cutoff, bandwidth or sample rate. VPM: one carrier and one modulator, 16 types, SHAPE = modulation depth, SHIFT + SHAPE = ratio, six offsets in edit mode. USR: oscillators loaded with the logue SDK.

behaviours.name: Modulation
behaviours.rule: EG to pitch (all), pitch 2 (VCO 2) or cutoff. LFO to cutoff, shape or pitch, with the target oscillators set in edit mode. Joystick X bends; Y+ and Y-, CV IN 1/2 and MIDI aftertouch each control one of 29 parameters at a set range.

behaviours.name: Effects
behaviours.rule: One modulation, one delay and one reverb at once, each storing its own on/off, type, time and depth; DEL/REV/MOD chooses which the controls edit. User effects load via the SDK (delay and reverb user effects not together).

behaviours.name: Sequencer
behaviours.rule: 16-step polyphonic: step recording (keys, REST for rests, REST with a key held for ties), real-time overdub, and up to four motion sequences of knobs and switches (not MASTER, TEMPO, OCTAVE, USR type, DRIVE, DEL/REV/MOD or SELECT). Step edit by holding step buttons. Saved with the program.

behaviours.name: Programs
behaviours.rule: Edits are lost without WRITE. SHIFT + WRITE loads the current panel as the sound. Program edit and seq edit settings save with the program; global settings save automatically.

behaviours.name: CV inputs
behaviours.rule: Modulation mode: two assignable CVs (-5 to +5 V). CV/Gate mode: CV IN 1 pitch (1 V/oct, 1 V = C4, -3 to +5 V), CV IN 2 gate (0-5 V).

receives.note: main sound parameters; CC 1 mod wheel and CC 64 damper always; numbers in Korg's separate MIDI implementation
program, scale and all-data dumps; user oscillator and effect loading

midi.channel_note: One channel 1-16; DIN and USB or USB only; filters for program change, CC and pitch bend in each direction.
midi.note: The CC number table is not in this manual.

specifications.sound_generation: 2 VCO, MULTI ENGINE, 1 VCF, 2 EG, 1 LFO, 1 VCA per voice

connections.sync: 3.5 mm in (20 V max) and out (5 V)

not_in_source: some edit-page value ranges (swing, step resolution, master tune)
source_inconsistencies: The TEMPO knob range is 56-240 BPM; the SEQ EDIT BPM parameter is 10-300.
MIDI Aftertouch lists its range as 'BALANCE...GATE TIME', but BALANCE is not in the assignable parameter list (GATE TIME to DELAY DEPTH).
The CV IN mode description calls the jacks 'CV1 IN1' and 'CV2 IN2'.
The manual says 'Favorrite' in the step-edit text.

modelling_gaps.detail: Voice modules are modelled once (per_voice); effects, sequencer and controllers are common.
Korg publishes the CC table separately; parameters carry panel and edit access only.
The keyboardless module (buttons 1-16 as a keyboard) shares this engine and is not modelled separately.
